catalog.note: RAICRS/DEICRS are J1991.25 positions. They are not relabelled as J2000 or current-date positions.

chartConvention.name: Stellarium Modern
chartConvention.attribution: Star-line figures adapted from Stellarium team, Modern sky culture, CC BY-SA 4.0. Catalog positions from ESA 1997, Hipparcos Catalogue ESA SP-1200, CDS/VizieR I/239/hip_main.
chartConvention.iauNote: IAU defines constellation boundaries and names, but no unique official stick figure. Selected edges are the Stellarium Modern convention, not an IAU-prescribed shape.

sources.role: name meanings and absence of official stick figures; not edge geometry

constellations.name: Circinus
constellations.designInterpretation: Compa vẽ kỹ thuật; liên hệ cấu trúc và độ chính xác là diễn giải thiết kế.

geometry.supportingStarPolicy: At most 12 brightest Johnson V <= 5.5 field stars, excluding stick-figure stars. No edge; a cone may include adjacent constellations. These are context, not members added to the figure.

projection.view: sky as seen from Earth, not exterior celestial globe
projection.normalization: same scalar for x/y; no independent stretch, mirroring or invented coordinates

referenceChart.role: comparison only; IAU/MacRobert patterns can differ from selected Modern figure

notes: Sparse source figure: 3 main stars / 2 edges. Do not invent nodes to fill space.
